name: One or two oversized objects
sourceCredit: Studio Feixen / Luzerner Theater (saved source caption and official identity project)
rules: The logical object remains continuous across repeated render passes.
Draw object behind display type, then repeat the same geometry through explicit foreground windows.
Supporting information uses local clearance based on actual glyph width, not a full-width paper stripe.
For edge and corner framing, fit an optional visible-ink target by sampling the actual native shape mask, then apply manual offsets.
Nudge display blocks away from occupied shape-mask regions while retaining safe paper bounds and avoiding other text blocks.
Store the original anchors, actual displacement vectors, object envelope, crop-fit translation, parameters, seed and clipped foreground passes.
Keep judging targets specific to framing: a deliberate tiny fragment does not need full-page ink coverage.
judgingBasis: Authored measured mask/framing/displacement ballots plus independent native Vision/Core ML and existing explicit-vote preference ballots; no synthetic user labels or new SigLIP training.
artisticPolicy: Pale-on-pale is permitted. No additional contrast penalty or rejection is applied.
